title: PhD position in Asset Pricing
industry: Economics, Financial Economics (JEL G), Economics and Social Sciences, Data Science, Finance
text:
Requirements are a successfully completed academic university degree (diploma/master), as well as interest and expertise in general equilibrium models, intermediary or demand-based asset pricing and data analysis. Basic knowledge of the German language is a plus (but not required).
The tasks include research in the area of asset pricing with a focus on equilibrium models and/or intermediary and demand-based asset pricing
Please send your applications no later than October 23rd to: Prof. Dr. Rüdiger Weber, Faculty of Economics and Business, Chair of Alternative Investments, Campus Westend, House of Finance, Theodor-W.-Adorno-Platz 3, 60323 Frankfurt am Main or (preferably) by e-mail to Kollmannsperger@finance.uni-frankfurt.de. Subject: „Research Assistant IAP“.
